checked_requirements.item: Git UI should feel closer to GitHub Desktop, not only a basic action panel.
checked_requirements.evidence: NativeGitWorkbench now has changed-file list, selected-file diff preview, and commit/sync panel.

checked_requirements.item: Users should be able to inspect changes before committing.
checked_requirements.evidence: Tauri status payload includes bounded diffPreview, additions, deletions, and file state flags.

checked_requirements.item: Git operations must remain native desktop workflow, not terminal input fields.
checked_requirements.evidence: Branch, commit, pull, push remain desktop action buttons; Work Console direct git remains optional.

checked_requirements.item: Sensitive credential boundary must not regress.
checked_requirements.evidence: Docs keep SSH/token/credential helper outside app storage; bounded command output remains redacted.

deferred_items.reason: Requires additional backend staging API and diff interaction model.

deferred_items.item: Stash, history graph, PR preview, conflict editor
deferred_items.reason: Outside this targeted workbench upgrade slice.
